To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The social construction of technology approach has been a useful framework for understanding the social shaping of technology, (2) SCOT scholarship has been primarily focused on agency and has neglected the influence of social structure, and (3) concepts from organizational sociology, political economy, and the new economic sociology can provide useful insights into structural factors that influence the social shaping of technologies.
the limited amount (1) of scholarship on structural (2) factors in the social (3) shaping (4) of technological development (5) presents numerous (6) opportunities for research (7).
the social shaping of technology is not only a social phenomenon but also a political phenomenon.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between technology and society and, in particular, the social construction of technological artifacts and systems.
the role of the social construction of technological knowledge in the emergence of the new biotechnologies.
understanding how the social and technical dimensions of technology are interwoven in the development process and how this interweaving is shaped by structural factors in society.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social construction of technological development is the outcome of a dynamic interaction between social structures, social agency, and the materiality of technology.
the structural approach to technology is a useful addition to the social constructionist approach.
the social construction of technologies, like the social construction of all other social phenomena, is a process of interaction between social structure and human agency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the social construction of technologies can be understood in terms of the social construction of organizations and institutions, and that the social construction and transformation of organizations and institutions can be understood in the context of the social construction and development of technology.
we need to understand more about how the social construction of technological development is shaped by social structures and how these structures are shaped by technological development.
we need to move from the social shaping of technology to the social structuring of technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SCOT scholars need to pay attention to the role of social structures in shaping the social construction of technologies.
SCOT scholars should be more attentive to structural factors in their work.

structural influences are important to understanding the social shaping of technology, and that the SCOT framework can be enhanced by the addition of structural concepts from other social science fields.
